text.text: As a native of Dallas, I needed to stay closer to the city for a conference and chose The Magnolia Hotel based off of the pictures and Expedia reviews. I checked in and checked out literally within 20 min, knowing I wouldn't receive a refund. The room was listed as a Deluxe Queen Room. Upon walking into the room I noticed how old everything was. The lampshade had a hole in it. The furniture was worn. No comforter on the bed, only sheets. I felt like I was in a motel and not a hotel. The front desk staff was very monotone and unapologetic. There was NO concern whatsoever when I clearly checked in and out in less than 30 min. That was disappointing. I understand being Historic, but this was horrible.

text.text:
Our stay at Magnolia Hotel Dallas Downtown was very enjoyable overall. First, this is not a knock on the hotel itself, but downtown Dallas traffic is pretty horrible, so be prepared for that when arriving and leaving.

The hotel has a classic old-school feel that gives it a lot of character, and the old Mobil Oil décor throughout the property was a really nice touch. The staff was attentive, friendly, and helpful during our stay, which always makes a difference.

The rooms were comfortable, well-kept, and the bed was especially comfortable for a good night’s sleep. The room rate itself felt fair for the location and quality of the hotel, although the $50 per night parking charge seemed a bit high.

The location worked well for us since there were several very good restaurants nearby, and it provided a quick exit to the tollway the next morning. Overall, it was a comfortable stay with plenty of charm and a convenient downtown location.

text.text:
Mandatory single valet charge of $54. I didn’t have an issue with the charge, I have an issue when I’m walking back from Starbucks at 6am and I see the headlights on with someone inside. It was valet “taking my car to the off site garage a few blocks away.”
I understand there are only like 10 spaces to park next to the building, but when half of them are empty at 6am and the owner isn’t notified to this first. Had it been two seconds later, I would have walked by to see my car gone and thought it was stolen. They literally asked for my number at the little valet booth during check in, seems sensible there’s a reason for this.

This incident made it hard to keep overlooking the outdated room/appliances. If the company can’t be bothered to offer any sort of onsite food,  put an ice machine on more than a single floor of a 21 story building, or contract a single valet fluent in English….  Clearly the guests experience is not high on the priority list.

My dogs bath water was yellow. Stepping in human urine on sidewalks can’t be avoided with the homeless presence on every block. It’s actually insulting that your carpet can’t be changed once in a decade.

Recommend anywhere else if you want to feel even slightly valued as a $157/night guest.

text.text:
Before I start the review, I would like to say the front desk staff was very nice and helpful so any negative thing about this hotel is not towards them.

I have stayed at many Holiday Inns. I have felt they are always the best for their price yet still clean. The first thing I noticed when I walked in our first room was streaks of someone’s bowel movement in the toilet where it hadn’t been cleaned good enough . I had to use the restroom anyways after a long drive and when I did the toilet leaked all over the floor from somewhere in the back and got on the bottom of my pants after I flushed. Luckily it was clean water. Other things I noticed on how banged up the furniture was in that room, as if it was second hand from another holiday inn. Old food crust was on the sofa in our first room. They did upgrade us to a king suite after that. In our new room, I noticed stains all over the furniture and the drain in the bathtub was nasty and old. The handle for the dresser on my side of the bed was gone.
Once again all the furniture looked second hand as if it was taken from another holiday inn that had remodeled. This place needs a remodel of the rooms bad. The front lobby looked great and from what I understand was recently remodeled. Put some more work and invest in the rooms your customers sleep in. I won’t be back at this location as it is not sanitary.

**Review for Holiday Inn Express & Suites Garland E - Lake Hubbard**

I recently had an outstanding experience at the Holiday Inn Express & Suites Garland E - Lake Hubbard. During my stay, I accidentally left my phone behind when I checked out. I was quite worried, but the staff's exceptional service put my mind at ease.

After realizing I had forgotten my phone, I contacted the hotel, and the team was incredibly helpful. They quickly located my phone and assured me they would keep it safe until I returned. Their prompt and caring response truly exceeded my expectations.

When I came back to retrieve my phone, the staff greeted me warmly and had it ready and waiting. Their professionalism and willingness to go the extra mile made a potentially stressful situation much easier.

I highly recommend Holiday Inn Express & Suites Garland E - Lake Hubbard not only for their excellent accommodations but also for their remarkable customer service. Thank you to the wonderful staff for making my experience so positive!

text.text:
DO NOT STAY HERE
Nothing luxury about this, not a hotel, not a place to bring kids, no one knows what they’re doing, they will lie to you and when you follow up about it everyone says it’s someone else’s job to handle it.
Promised me 2pm check-in over the phone.  Also told me there’s a restaurant in the building I could sit in (was cold outside) until room was ready if I arrived before 2. When I arrived at 2 the room had not been cleaned from previous guest.  I had to flag down a cleaner who had to radio to another cleaner to “rush the cleaning” and it was still not ready until after 3 which is the advertised check-in time. The “restaurant” is a bodega where they serve food.  There are no seats inside.  You can sit outside in an alley where I was with all my luggage as a circle of homeless guys smoked a blunt right next to me.  Room smelled like some kind of wood finish or adhesive.  Had my door pounded down randomly by a maintenance guy answering a call from the previous guest that I was never made aware of and he had to work on the fridge during my stay.  Other than a girl Janelle who was helpful, no one that works here knows anything.  I received wrong information from everyone else I was in contact with on all matters.  I was told they offer a shuttle to the airport.  They never said they charge for this but they do.  They texted me during my stay a coupon for $5 to the “restaurant” downstairs with a link.  Clicked link > restaurant menu > ordered food, no $5.  They’ve been telling me they’ll refund me and it’s weeks later they never did.  I’m told the CEO is reviewing my requests lol.  The CEO… Don’t stay here.

UPDATE: Responding to management’s response.  I have the audio file of the phone call where they promised 2pm checkin BEFORE I booked the room. They didn't say "try" they said I could checkin at 2.  They still haven’t even sent me the $5.  The guy I spoke to told me he’d personally refund me the money for the uber to the hotel admitting the confusion over the shuttle service was on them and I told him not to worry as he told me he has 4 daughters and he told me the “CEO” would likely reimburse me. She did not.

Amy Finehouse Lofts and Vacation Rentals were exceptional to rent from. I needed a last-minute local stay for a couple of nights and booked a place in Downtown Dallas. In my rush, I accidentally reserved the wrong unit. At first, it seemed like they might not be able to make the change, but the amazing team at Amy Finehouse went above and beyond. Not only did they help correct the booking, they upgraded me as well.

From reservation to checkout, the customer service and hospitality were truly outstanding. The loft itself was extraordinary: beautiful, comfortable, and exactly what I needed for a stress-free, relaxing stay. Thank you for elevating the bar and providing 10-star service. I highly recommend Amy Finehouse Lofts and Vacation Rentals!

text.text:
Stayed here during a business trip and had a suite with a kitchen and two sleeping areas. The room was clean and the location was convenient, which were definitely positives.
That said, there were several design and maintenance issues that would keep me from staying here again. The separate bedroom doesn't have its own A/C unit, so if you close the door for privacy, very little cool air reaches the room. The shower had extremely low water pressure, the tub diverter didn't fully seal, and the shower head leaked continuously. There were also large holes in the wall where a thermostat or HVAC controller had apparently been removed. The dishwasher is not attached to the wall.

The bedroom door was on spring hinges with no doorstop, making it difficult to keep open without wedging it against the dresser. The bathroom sink drained very slowly as well.
My biggest complaint is the layout. The suite sleeps a lot of people with three beds plus a pullout sofa, yet there is only one bathroom. It would have made much more sense to have two connecting rooms with two bathrooms rather than trying to fit so many sleeping spaces into a single-bathroom setup.
Overall, the room was clean and the location was good, but the combination of maintenance issues and the room design means I would choose a different hotel next time.

I stayed at this location last week for 1 ngt only but ended up staying another 3 ngts..

Front desk Ali was awesome. She was very welcoming and helped me out with extending my stay for multiple days, even though they had low availability. She made it work

He and his team helped us with all our bags, all the way to the room. I have a lot of respect for his sincerity and respect for elders. He made me and my grandmother feel welcome and made our stay painless.

text.text:
I don’t usually leave reviews, but I felt compelled to share my experience before even heading to my flight. Unfortunately, this Staybridge Suites fell well below expectations. The property feels dated, with worn furniture that gives the impression of a budget motel rather than a hotel in such a prime location.

The overall aesthetic doesn’t align with the surrounding area, which makes the experience even more disappointing. Management was another concern the GM came across as dismissive and overly talkative, without actually addressing guest needs in a meaningful way.

That said, one bright spot was a front desk associate Shawna, if I recall correctly who was exceptionally helpful and professional. She stood out as the only truly positive part of the stay.

The social hour offerings were underwhelming and lacked quality. As someone who works as a trade show market manager, I pay close attention to service standards, and it was clear the team is not aligned with what guests expect at this level.
